brief: Kamei, Singular Euclidean structures on a simplicial complex with weighted edges (2003) — extends Rivin's geometric structures on a 2-simplicial complex to weighted-edge assignments.
extended:
**Singular Euclidean Structures on a Simplicial Complex with Weighted Edges** — Satoshi Kamei, Graduate School of Mathematical Sciences, University of Tokyo. Received July 2002, final version January 2003.

Considers geometric structures on a simplicial complex. Rivin treated geometric structures on a 2-simplicial complex homeomorphic to an orientable surface when values are assigned to the edges; this extends that setting.

**Why it may bear here.** Companion to the Rivin variational material also held (`arxiv-math-9907032v1`, combinatorial optimization in geometry). Weighted-edge singular Euclidean structures are the same family of objects.
